_schema.description: Per-volume manuscript and edition sigla used in the Quaracchi Opera Omnia of Bonaventure. Each volume in the Quaracchi edition has its own sigla key printed in its prolegomena; entries here should be populated from that key. A later script can aggregate all volumes into a cross-reference glossary once the project is complete.
_schema.population_strategy: Start with entries encountered in apparatus during translation. As each volume's prolegomena is re-OCR'd, populate the full sigla key for that volume in one pass.
